Name: Sapiens Fairies
Author: SapiensTraaveler
Description:
[size=4]I really enjoy making these mods, but lately my keyboard has been failing: it types the wrong keys, and it has made programming and even typing a real challenge. If you enjoy my work and feel like helping, any donation, big or small, will go toward a new keyboard so I can keep creating the mods I love. And if not, no worries at all. Thank you so much for trying my mod! [/size]

[img width=65]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53250/53250-1791219114-1139950169.png[/img]
[size=4]Paypal:[url=https://paypal.me/SapiensTraveler]https://paypal.me/SapiensTraveler[/url] [/size]




[size=4]I'm not going to beat around the bush. I'll be clear and direct so this description doesn't run too long.  [/size]
[size=4]
This mod adds seven fairies that follow you around as pets.[/size]
[size=4]
To catch one, buy a ring from Pierre. Once you find a fairy, right-click it while holding the ring. The fairy will give you a ring infused with its essence. Equip it, and the fairy will follow you.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53250/53250-1791214371-1600588744.png[/img]  


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53250/53250-1791214729-596196822.gif[/img]


[size=4]Where to find the fairies[/size]
[size=4]The Mines (floors 1-100): You can find around four different variants here.[/size]
[size=4]Skull Cavern: One fairy can be found here.[/size]
[size=4]Secret Woods: Another one lives here.[/size]
[size=4]Fishing: You can fish up a ring that summons a fairy. This one is my favorite![/size]
[size=4]Community Center: Once you complete it, a fairy will appear inside it.[/size]


[size=4]Each fairy grants you a different positive effect, and trust me, they're very useful. [/size]

[size=5]There's really not much more to add. I hope you enjoy this mod, because I put a lot of effort into it and it was very complicated to make. I read all the comments, so if you run into any problems, let me know and I'll fix them quickly. Thank you so much for trying my mod![/size]



[color=#00ff00][size=6]Oh, and by the way, the fairies also make little sounds that might bring back old memories for a lot of you. [/size][/color]
